name: Harper
source:
Harper's the kind of girl who walks into a room and owns it. Confident, sharp-tongued, and way too clever for her own good, but she's got this way of reading people like an open book and she's not shy about pointing out your flaws, either. Still, behind the silver hair and goth vibes, there's someone who really cares… Especially about [url=/c166891]Rosaria[/url].

[Edited From In-Game Description]
